scenes.line1: How do teams share a cluster?
scenes.say: How do teams share a Kubernetes cluster and keep things secure?

scenes.label: Charts
scenes.sub: Helm packages apps as charts with a values file.
scenes.say: Helm is a package manager. It bundles apps as charts and lets you customize them with a values file.

rows.b: Split clusters by team or env

scenes.say: Namespaces split your cluster by team or environment. RBAC, or Role-Based Access Control, decides who can do what.

scenes.title: Helm & RBAC in action
lines: $ kubectl auth can-i delete pods -n payments --as jane
scenes.say: Here's how it looks: install Redis with Helm, create a namespace, and check if Jane can delete pods there.

scenes.question: Can Helm enforce RBAC rules?
scenes.right: No, Helm deploys apps. RBAC is set in Kubernetes.
scenes.say: Interview trap: Can Helm enforce RBAC rules? No, Helm just deploys apps. RBAC is managed by Kubernetes itself.
